project.title: Pick Your AI — Datasets & Benchmark Research
project.description: Evidence-backed research on AI datasets and benchmarks: identity, versions, rights, provenance, evaluation integrity and integrations.

representation.rule: Independently reviewable outcomes are native sub-issues; tasks and subtasks are nested checklist entries in their work package issue.

items.title: Pick Your AI datasets and benchmark research program
items.summary: Establish and run evidence-backed research on AI datasets and benchmarks: identity, versions, rights, provenance, evaluation integrity and integration with existing Pick Your AI research and consumers.
deliverables: Twelve epics with accepted work packages
Accepted handoffs to research, catalog pipeline, papers, applications and website
evidence_requirements: All factual records cite public sources with access dates; synthetic fixtures stay in tests/
acceptance_criteria: Every epic satisfies its own acceptance
Coverage is reported against declared denominators
No restricted dataset content is stored in the repository
non_goals: Running benchmarks or reporting model scores
Changing the frozen T0-T6 builder contract

items.title: Scope, taxonomy and governance
items.summary: Define what the datasets and benchmark directory covers, how coverage is measured, who decides, and how it relates to research already owned elsewhere.

evidence_requirements: Inherited from child work packages
acceptance_criteria: All child work packages are accepted or explicitly deferred with a decision record

items.title: Directory charter and inclusion/exclusion rules
items.summary: Decide what counts as a dataset, benchmark, split, derived dataset or evaluation suite for this directory, and what is excluded.
deliverables: Versioned inclusion and exclusion rules with worked boundary examples
evidence_requirements: Each boundary example cites the public dataset card or paper that makes it a boundary case
acceptance_criteria: Every entity kind has an inclusion rule, an exclusion rule and at least two boundary examples
Rules distinguish datasets, benchmarks, benchmark runs and benchmark results
A decision-register entry records the approval and reviewer
non_goals: Collecting or listing any dataset record
Changing the frozen T0-T6 builder contract

handoffs.artifact: Inclusion rules shared with research #509 coverage ledger

subtasks.title: Define dataset, benchmark, split, subset and derived dataset
Define benchmark run and benchmark result as separate kinds owned outside this repository
Record the source of each definition
Write one inclusion and one exclusion rule per kind
Add at least two boundary examples per kind
List known ambiguous cases as open questions
Link the approved charter from README

items.title: Dataset taxonomy and controlled vocabularies

items.summary: Specify dataset comparison views, citation formats and permitted exports that respect rights and comparability rules.
evidence_requirements: Export permissions cite the rights matrix
acceptance_criteria: Comparisons enforce scoring comparability rules
Exports include only fields permitted for redistribution
Citations credit the original publisher

items.title: Accessibility and localization requirements
items.summary: Specify accessibility and localization requirements for directory content and metadata.
deliverables: Localization rules for metadata and taxonomy labels
evidence_requirements: Requirements cite WCAG 2.2
acceptance_criteria: Requirements are testable
Original-language titles are preserved alongside translations
Website owners review

items.title: Contribution, freshness and maintenance
items.summary: Run the contributor workflow, freshness monitoring, corrections, editorial review, testing, publication acceptance and long-term maintenance.
deliverables: Accepted work packages DATA-12.01 to DATA-12.06
evidence_requirements: Inherited from child work packages
acceptance_criteria: All child work packages are accepted or explicitly deferred with a decision record
Epic-level handoffs are acknowledged by receiving owners
non_goals: Work outside the child work packages

items.title: Contributor workflow and templates
items.summary: Provide contributor instructions, issue forms and PR templates for proposing dataset and benchmark records.
evidence_requirements: Templates cite the organization contribution policy
acceptance_criteria: Templates collect identity, version, source and rights fields
PR template requires validation results and evidence
Workflow follows organization branch rules

items.title: Freshness monitoring and refresh cadence
items.summary: Define per-source freshness targets, how staleness is detected and how refreshes are scheduled.
evidence_requirements: Targets cite the source update frequency where published
acceptance_criteria: Each record has a last-checked date
Stale records map to the Source Freshness field
Refresh never overwrites without a new check

items.title: Corrections and editorial review
items.summary: Define how corrections are reported, reviewed, applied and disclosed.
evidence_requirements: Corrections cite the evidence that supports them
acceptance_criteria: Corrections are reviewed independently
Published corrections are disclosed with date
Correction form exists
non_goals: Handling legal takedowns, which belong to DATA-05.05

items.title: Validation, testing and CI
items.summary: Maintain the plan and catalog validators, regression tests and required CI checks.
deliverables: Validators for plan, catalog and docs
evidence_requirements: Not applicable: tooling package
acceptance_criteria: CI runs all validators and tests on every PR
The required check is enforced by ruleset
Validators reject each documented defect class

items.title: Publication acceptance and release
items.summary: Define publication gates, release manifests and acceptance records for the first eligible subset.
evidence_requirements: Each release cites its manifest and review records
acceptance_criteria: A release requires rights, editorial and evidence acceptance per record
Withheld records cannot be released
Release manifest validates

items.title: Long-term maintenance and ownership
items.summary: Define maintenance ownership, review rotation and the criteria for retiring or archiving parts of the directory.
evidence_requirements: Not applicable: policy package
acceptance_criteria: Each workstream names an owning team role
Archival criteria are documented
Plan approved in the decision register
